member.name: M:Template.Core.Api.Auth.AuthController.Refresh(Template.Core.App.Auth.DataTransfer.RefreshRequest,System.Threading.CancellationToken)
member.summary: Renews the session from a valid refresh token, issuing a new access/refresh pair.
member.remarks: Refresh is stateless (ADR 08): the previous refresh token is not rotated or revoked and remains valid until it expires. There is no server-side logout — session revocation is finding F4 from the July/2026 audit report, planned for v0.0.2 (ATOS-81). Today, the only way to invalidate sessions is to rotate the signing key, which brings down every session at once.
member.response: New access token and refresh token.

member.name: F:Template.Core.Api.Config.ForwardedHeadersConfig.DefaultNetworks
member.summary: Private ranges (RFC 1918) plus loopback. On Render the edge reaches the container over the private network, so the peer always falls into one of these.
